summary: The tag makes a link and the tag shows an image. A link needs href (where to go), and an image needs src (the file) and alt (a text description).
notes: alt should say what the image shows or does. Screen readers read it aloud, and it appears if the image fails to load.
href="#contact" jumps to the element with id="contact" on the same page. mailto: opens an email app.
Set width and height on so the page saves the right space before the image loads.
pitfall: Leaving out alt. Screen readers then read the file name, and for a data: URI that is a long string of code.
